item.title: Luno Solar Bags Solar Module Orders For DRDO, Bangalore Solar Project
item.description: Indian solar module manufacturer Luno Solar has secured an order to supply solar modules for a solar project being developed at a Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) facility in Bengaluru. The module supply contract has been awarded by NTPC Limited, which is implementing the solar project for the research organisation. item.title: ENGIE, NLC India, Rays Power & Oriana Bag SECI 1200 MW Solar With 6-Hr BESS Tender
item.description: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has announced the winners of its 1,200 MW solar power tender coupled with 600 MW / 3,600 MWh of battery energy storage system (BESS) with a six-hour storage duration. The successful bidders include ENGIE, NLC India, RPIL Power Three Pvt Ltd, and Oriana Power. item.title: Egypt Signs USD 1.8 Billion Deals with Scatec and Sungrow For Major Solar and Battery Projects
item.description: Egypt has inked agreements exceeding USD 1.8 billion with Norway's Scatec and China's Sungrow to advance two key renewable energy initiatives, boosting the country's green infrastructure. Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly witnessed the signing alongside top officials, as announced by the Cabinet. item.description: India's Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy, Pralhad Joshi, delivered the country's national statement at the 16th Assembly of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) in Abu Dhabi, UAE, on January 12, 2026. item.title: China Gives, China Takes- Solar Module Prices Set To Rise?
item.description: China has announced the withdrawal of the export VAT rebates for solar photovoltaic modules and other products from April 1, 2026. The move, while announced earlier, had not formalised a final date yet. From the same date, the rebate on battery products will go down to 6% from the existing 9%. By Jan 1, 2027, the rebate on battery products will also be taken to zero. item.title: AP Govt Approves Websol’s 4 GW Solar Cell and Module Manufacturing Project
item.description: Websol Energy System Limited has announced that the Andhra Pradesh government, through its Industries & Commerce Department, has issued a government order approving the company’s proposed greenfield 4 GW solar cell and solar module manufacturing project. The manufacturing facility will be located at the Multiproduct Special Economic Zone (MPSEZ) in Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh. item.title: Rajasthan Issues India's Biggest Ever 2.45 GW/6.4 GWh Solar-Plus-BESS Tender at Pugal
item.description: The Rajasthan government has issued a solar-plus-storage tender for 2,450 MW of solar power projects, along with 1,600 MW/6,400 MWh of Energy Storage Systems (ESS). Mirroring the approach adopted in Gujarat’s Khavda solar project, Rajasthan is now eyeing Pugal as a single-location hub for future solar and energy storage projects in the state.
